edits.value: Backend and data engineer with six years designing distributed systems and warehouse pipelines that stay fast under production load. At Anchor Data Systems, rebuilt a nightly 200GB data warehouse load with Python, SQL, and change data capture, cutting the window from 6 hours to 45 minutes, and rewrote the 15 slowest queries to drop average dashboard load from 12 seconds to 2 seconds. At Northbeam Logistics, led the system design for a Java and Spring Boot microservices architecture on Kafka that moved 5 downstream services from 30-second polling to under 2-second real-time event consumption.

Led the system design for splitting the fulfillment platform's order-processing monolith into Java and Spring Boot microservices behind Kafka topics, giving each of 6 core services its own deploy pipeline and contract tests and cutting cross-team release conflicts 60% across 40 backend services.

Scaled peak shipping-week read traffic by adding a Redis cache with a 5-minute TTL and write-invalidation hook in front of PostgreSQL cart and pricing reads, cutting p95 read latency 45% and PostgreSQL CPU usage 30%.

Cut order-status notification lag from 30 seconds to under 2 seconds by migrating 5 downstream services from PostgreSQL polling to real-time Kafka event consumption with idempotent handlers, dropping database polling load 70%.

Rebuilt the nightly 200GB data warehouse load in Python and SQL around incremental change data capture (CDC) from PostgreSQL source tables, cutting the load window from 6 hours to 45 minutes and improving reliability to zero missed maintenance windows across 2 years.

Standardized the analytics schema for maintainability by normalizing 30 ad hoc tables into a documented star schema and making CDC the contract with 8 downstream teams, cutting silent schema breaks from 2 a year to zero over the following 18 months.
Backend & Data Engineer · Data Warehouse & Analytics Platform · 200GB nightly load, 8 downstream teams · Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, CDC
Personal project: generative AI question answering over internal engineering docs using retrieval-augmented search
